story.hookLine: Pick whoever you want from the roster; open on their own line, verbatim. Their words are the piece; yours are the frame.

approach: Voices approach: this slice is a roster, a tip sheet, not your assignment — every citizen with a page on the record, one line each. You pick whose own words carry the day, and why. The person's own line first, before their name; then who they are in one plain clause; then what in the city they were answering, from the page's own tags. Fewer, longer passages; the words are the product. Never a count, never a statistic, never an explanation of what they meant. Facts on this slice: the names, places, roles and numbers listed. Those are real; do not invent people or places. Everything else about this beat — what it looks like, who is there, what they want and hate — is yours to paint.
